item.title: Fix failing unittest bug in window.py
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix. Do not edit test files. Read window.py and the failing test output first, fix the root cause in window.py, re-run `python3 -m unittest` until it passes, and check edge cases (empty input, boundary indices, single element) by reading the code. Commit with a message describing the fix, using the configured git identity only.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in sliding_windows (window.py). The start-index range was range(len(items) - size), which dropped the last window. It is now range(len(items) - size + 1). Before: sliding_windows([1,2,3],2) returned [[1,2]] and sliding_windows([1,2],2) returned []. Now they return [[1,2],[2,3]] and [[1,2]]. Empty input and size > len still return []; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Checks: `python3 -m unittest` runs 3 tests, all OK, before and after the fix. Edge probes matched expected output: [] size 1, [1] size 1, [1,2] size 2 and 3, [1,2,3] size 2 and 3, tuple input. No test files changed.
